question: What practice concerning the soul is being declared as having been told to the addressee?
premises: This practice of the soul has been told to you.
The statement is made emphatically by repetition of the dative.
inference: The practice concerning the soul has now been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full details of that practice are not given in this verse alone.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
